title: shadPS4 0.8.0: official stable release
summary: shadPS4 published 0.8.0 on April 23, 2025. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.8.0 on April 23, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: Another exciting release from shadPS4 team coming today . This time our release is dedicated to one of our latest Uber Dev "stephen". A lot of new fixes , features have come up with this release let's sum some below.
